title: Mall World last night
content: I frequent this place a lot, usually there are 3 floors but this time there were 4 , I went to the second one briefly and looked in one of the bedrooms, but whoever I was with went downstairs and I followed because of how terrifying upstairs is. I remember there being dark wood trim in the bedrooms. The bedrooms (there are lots of them) are around the perimeter of the second floor, but there is a indoor courtyard type area in the middle of each floor with a balcony to look down. I spoke to a woman who worked there and I asked her if it was normal for me to have reoccurring dreams of this place. However, when I asked I was not aware it was a dream. She said YES. She also told me it costs 100 dollars a day to heat the place. (which means its somewhere cold maybe?) I was also for whatever reason aware that this place was for sale at some point in the recent past. Sorry these are just random thoughts, tried to write them down before I forgot everything.
